verdict.rationale: Mercury markets syncing with QuickBooks, Xero, or NetSuite plus 'AI-powered automations to close your books faster' (mercury-docs-6). It also exposes transaction categorization and category management through its API and agent write actions (mercury-docs-12, mercury-docs-29). However, nothing explicitly says the AI assigns GL codes automatically, and multi-entity handling is never mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit AI auto-assignment of GL codes or accounts, cross-entity or multi-entity coding support, detail on how coding maps into the ERP during close, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
